name: Zanzou ― Kiwamete Kojin Teki na Fuan no Toushizu Digital Novel
original_name: 残像―極めて個人的な不安の透視図 digital novel
source:
I’m just an office worker who goes back and forth between work and home. One day, in the underground passage of an abandoned train station, I find a young boy being assaulted by a group of men.
Should I assault him too? Or should I stop?
Should I take him home? Or should I not?
If I take him home, dress him in women’s clothes, hold him close every night as he clings to me, and then…
